gate_or_program: APPUI-COMP-11 - Empty / Unavailable / Transitional Workspace Integration
design_axis: APP VISUAL real workspace-state truth inside one shell
bounded_question: Can five accepted workspace-state families live inside the real COMP shell while preserving application truth and fictional boundaries without freezing Product-dependent lifecycle/provider mechanics?

close_reconciliation.effect: Website main remains app-UI-frozen; Engineering advances E0-D Slot-2 authorization/evidence only and adds no Product/UI semantics altering this state grammar.

controlled_inputs: Light F2 / Dark D3 / MAT F1 / TYP F1 / STA F2 / FICON F1
accepted empty/unavailable/transitional functional and Phase-3 evidence

local_result.summary: The real shell now carries five distinct state families: valid empty/no-active-Scene, loading/transitional, capability unavailable, failed/cancelled and provisional/non-effective. State changes are condition-driven evidence hooks rather than user-facing Product commands; fictional truth remains untouched.

mechanical: seven-case origin + all-five-states + exact-return matrix PASS
zero forbidden lifecycle/retry/fallback/recover buttons and zero state-surface form controls
visual: wide and narrow Light/Dark empty-state framing uses Production, not Current situation
loading, unavailable, failed/cancelled and provisional states retain one hierarchy across themes
dashed/dotted structure differentiates relevant witnesses without semantic status colors

interaction: test-only state hook exercises evidence conditions but creates no Product UI/runtime command
keyboard focus is visibly independent of state meaning and returns to retained creator focus when valid
Back/Close is navigation and never becomes Undo, recovery, retry or lifecycle mutation
empty state removes Current-situation framing and restores it when returning to a valid prior task

constrains: Future state carriers preserve empty-valid, infrastructure-versus-fiction, failed-no-effect, provisional-versus-effective and return-context distinctions unless a named successor supersedes them.

explicit_non_authority: No Create/Start/Resume Scene, Take, branch, rehearsal, retry, fallback or provider command.
No loading duration, progress algorithm, cancellation, retry, recovery, provider/model/cost or failure policy.
No final Scene lifecycle, consequence, timer/transcript/Pause, production-token freeze, native implementation or Stage successor.

director_review_surface.what_to_review: five state families, empty-state Production framing, infrastructure-versus-fiction boundary, provisional/effective distinction and exact return

synthesis_state.next_boundary: Audit PKT-COMP-01-01 through PKT-COMP-11-01 as one integrated coverage set before authorizing any new component gate.
